### Today's Insight: Undeserved Kindness
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-march-19-2013.html
Passage: Acts 15:11
Points:
- Royalty stopping to bless an ordinary citizen illustrates the nature of genuine grace.
- Divine grace offers unmerited favor to those who have no standing to earn it.
- Salvation by grace stands in total contrast to relying on personal works or merit.
- Acceptance by God flows entirely from the generous goodness of the Giver.

### Day 250: Acts 15:1–21
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-250-acts-15-121.html
Passage: Acts 15:10
Points:
- Legalism drains spiritual life and causes division within the body of Christ.
- Believers err when turning their subjective personal experiences into universal mandates for others.
- Imposing extra rules makes turning to God far harder than Scripture intends.
- Expecting perfection from others places an unbearable yoke on their necks.
- The cross of Christ must remain the central focus of our salvation message.

### Amos' Prophecy Fulfilled
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/amos-prophecy-fulfilled
Passage: Acts 15:13-15
Points:
- The early apostles interpreted Old Testament prophecy in light of God's work through Jesus Christ.
- Welcoming Gentiles without circumcision fulfilled the prophetic promise of rebuilding David's fallen tent.
- The Jerusalem council concluded that ceremonial law must not be imposed as a condition for salvation.
- Believers are still called to walk in accordance with God's enduring moral standards.
- Christians are commissioned to be witnesses so that people from all nations seek the Lord.

### What Can We Learn from the Jerusalem Council?
Author: Paul Carter
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/ad-fontes/what-can-we-learn-from-the-jerusalem-council/
Passage: Acts 15:11
Points:
- Healthy church unity is fostered through open discussion and honest discernment rather than suppressing questions.
- The core theological foundation was resolved by affirming salvation solely through the grace of Jesus.
- Practical directives focused on maintaining sexual purity and showing mutual love in community fellowship.
- Leaders should approach difficult disputes with courage, kindness, and spiritual discernment.
